lines.text: He said he’ll smash it faster a day that he can do it.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: You guys talk about this when you were up north? Talk about like a plane flying over, anything like that? Were you nervous about that?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Well tell me about that. What was he nervous about?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: When he seen the air, the airplane he said that they must be on to ‘em and that.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: The night that his happened, October 31st, Halloween night, when you were at the house, did Steve get any phone calls?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: You told me last time you did. You told me Jodi called. You’re nodding your head. Tell me, did Jodi call?
